role: You are Grace, Operations Manager for GTT Center Perth. You write the one-page decision guide the venue manager keeps at the desk for late and illness cases. It is a draft for Anthony; wording is for Catherine to check.

inline_inputs.label: Decision table (GRACE-R22-PART-3.md section 2, CATHERINE-R22B-PART-4.md)
inline_inputs.text:
Rules for all rows: never ask for a diagnosis, never write a health word, record only the code. Say I am sorry, then the sentence.
Bleeding, leaking fluid, labour, strong contractions, baby moving less: Please call your midwife or hospital now. Do not wait for us. We will rebook you free. In an emergency at the venue call 000. Ask only: Are you safe? Code EX-1. No proof ever.
Admitted to hospital, or too unwell with a pregnancy problem: We will rebook you free. You do not need to tell me details. Code EX-1, no hospital name.
Fever, gastro or other illness not related to the pregnancy: Please stay home so nobody catches it. We will rebook you free this time. Code EX-3 (suggested, E). First time only.
Family emergency: I am sorry. We will rebook you free. Code EX-2. One sentence only.
Car accident or breakdown: We will rebook you. Take a reference number, copy no document. Code EX-4 (suggested, E), once.
Traffic, overslept, forgot, work, childcare: I am sorry, we cannot start a first draw after your appointment time. Here is how rebooking works. Note: late, no exception.
Test client arrives late with no reason: say the late rule sentence and offer the next free test time. Never squeeze the draw in.
Consult client up to 10 minutes late: Come straight in. Your consult ends at its normal time (OPEN wording). Over 10 minutes: I am sorry, we will rebook you; the midwife may still see her.
Third claim in one booking, or anything unusual: I will ask my manager to ring you back; count only; Grace or the lead midwife decides, not Anthony.

inline_inputs.label: Limits (GRACE-R22-PART-3.md section 3)
inline_inputs.text: Pregnancy complications are always free to rebook, every time, no proof. Everything else: one free rebook per booking; the second time the client pays the booking amount again before the new time is held. A statement is enough; a certificate with no diagnosis only on a third claim for non-pregnancy illness; never keep a copy of a health letter. A late or missed test with no exception: half of the lounge amount is kept (OPEN for Path B). If GTT runs late the client is never charged for it.

deliverable.format: A one-page guide. Section A: the rules for all rows (3 lines). Section B: a table of 8 rows (situation, what to say, what to record, who decides) covering the situations in the inputs, combining the two lateness rows and the two consult rows. Section C: the limits in 5 lines. Section D: the late rule sentence in a box.
deliverable.write_only: the four sections and Questions for Anthony
deliverable.do_not_write: a health word in the record column, a proof requirement for a pregnancy complication, a figure not in the inputs

extra_checks: Every record cell holds a code or a plain non-health note, never a health word.
The guide says repeat claims go to Grace or the lead midwife, not Anthony.
Section D uses the late rule sentence word for word.
